text: iCall India: 9152987821. Free, confidential, trained counselors. Available Mon-Sat 8am-10pm.
Vandrevala Foundation: 1860-2662-345. 24/7 helpline. Hindi and English support available.
NIMHANS Helpline: 080-46110007. National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences.
Crisis response principle: Never argue with someone in crisis. Validate first. Give hotline. Stay present.
Means restriction: Gently ask if person has access to means of self-harm. If yes, involve family or emergency services.
Safety planning: Ask user to identify 3 people to call if feeling worse. Write them down. Share the list.
